patch_list: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml.
Bypasses the PairIP Google Play Licensing check so Atlas Photo runs without a valid Play Store license.

Forces Atlas Photo's Hermes (React Native) JS runtime to treat every session as a Pro subscriber by patching the setIsProMember store writer, so the isProMember flag is always truthy. Unlocks all Pro features and removes the Pro paywall.
